in_hebrew.name: חרית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A form of the Hebrew name Hadasah, which means 'my joy' or 'my delight'. This name is mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of a woman who returned from exile with the Babylonian captives (Ezra 10:2).

in_greek.name: Χάρρη
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word χάρρα (charrá), which means 'joy' or 'gladness'. It is also a variant of the name Charis, which means 'grace' or 'favor'. The name Carri is not found in the New Testament, but it is a common Greek name in antiquity.

in_latin.name: Carrita
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word carus, which means 'dear' or 'precious'. The name Carri is a feminine form of the Latin name Carrus, which means 'wagon' or 'cart'. However, the name Carri is not commonly used in the Latin world and is not found in any known Latin texts.
